newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian bond futures fall on modest budget.
newsitem.headline: Australian bond futures fall on modest budget.

text.p: Australian bond futures dropped sharply in immediate response to Treasurer Peter Costello's 1997/98 Federal budget, which failed to live up to market expectations.
By 7.35 p.m. (0935 GMT) the June 10-year bond futures contract had fallen to 92.270 from 92.360 just prior to Costello handing down the budget.

Costello projected a underlying budget deficit for 1997/98 of A$3.9 billion compared with median forecasts for around a A$2.0 billion shortfall, while he predicted a headline budget surplus of A$6.4 billion.
The Treasury also predicted debt issuance of A$6.5 to A$7.5 billion when little or no net issuance was expected on a larger budget surplus approaching A$10.0 billion.
The Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) trading floor is open for a special budget session until 8.15 p.m. (1015 GMT).
